Contents 1 Contestants who performed Katy Perry 2 Early Career 3 American Idol 4 Overview 5 Gallery 5.1 Videos 6 External Links Contestants who performed Katy Perry[] Kaibrienne. Early Career[] Katy Perry was born and raised in Santa Barbara, California. American Idol[] Perry first appeared in American Idol as a guest judge during Season 9 for the first day of the Los Angeles auditions. She even performed on the show wearing a cape with Adam Lambert's name on it, on the Top 3 results show of Season 8. She was announced as a judge for Season 16 on ABC on May 16, 2017. The decision received some criticism due to reports of her earning possibly $25 million for the job. She left the judging panel after Season 22, to focus on her music career being replaced by Season 4 winner Carrie Underwood. Overview[] Prior to American Idol, Perry was best known for her music, including her notable singles "I Kissed a Girl", "Teenage Dream", "Roar", and "Dark Horse". She made her acting debut in an episode of How I Met Your Mother as the character Honey.
